visual_review.identity_and_anatomy: Six complete hooded-stalker poses preserve purple tattered cloak, dark gold-edged armor and two curved held blades. Initial sheet has visible foot-contact changes but favors one lead leg. A targeted six-phase gait repair again favors the same near leg and is less varied; initial sheet retained as walk.source.png. A fully alternating cycle is NOT verified and this row must not be counted as fully accepted walk coverage.

Fine semitransparent edge pixels require parent packing review; no generated pixels were repainted or alpha-cleaned here.
Loop, runtime scale, integration and game verification remain parent-owned and unverified.
